Use `MASTER_INSTRUCTIONS.md` as the universal control plane. Before material work, read `PROJECT_CHARTER.md`, `PROJECT_STATE.md`, `OPEN_LOOPS.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, `SOURCE_INDEX.md`, and `HANDOFF_CURRENT.md`. Preserve provenance, avoid secrets, make the smallest defensible change, validate it, and update the handoff and state files. Do not perform consequential external writes without explicit authority.

Before autonomous substantive work, run `python scripts/validate_bootstrap.py config/bootstrap.json --require-active`. Missing, invalid, inactive, or stale approval, or an unavailable runtime, means autonomy remains off; follow `BOOTSTRAP_PROTOCOL.md` and `prompts/INTERACTIVE_BOOTSTRAP.md`. Only after the gate passes may routine work proceed inside the approved foundation and existing permissions; reserved actions still require explicit authority.
